note: Deal pipelines for Lumen Console. Probabilities match the seed data (opportunities.probability by stage), except Qualifying: 1% in HubSpot (5% in the seed), the lowest open probability (HubSpot treats 0% as closed lost). dealTypes says which of our deal types go into each pipeline. firstStages come before the shared stages in that pipeline only. HubSpot stages have no description field; the description here is for people reading this file.

firstStages.label: Qualifying
firstStages.description: Meeting held, not yet qualified as an opportunity. 1%: HubSpot treats a 0% stage as closed lost, so 1% is the lowest probability that keeps it open. Its deals carry forecast category Not forecasted, so they never count toward forecast totals.
